title: Ranking draft
description: Snapshot of the facilitator's ranking screen (FR-015a steps 2 to 4, FR-015b), never stored. levels go from the highest to the lowest level, features of a level are tied; unranked are the features waiting in "Non classées (sans valeur)". values holds the value of each ranked feature for criterionKey, by featureId; null or missing means no value. A feature appears at most once, criterionKey is one of criterionKeys, and only ranked features have a value.

criterionKeys.description: Criteria chosen at step 1, in method definition order
